row:
ShawTV South Vancouver Island brings you entertaining, informative and hyper-local stories about your community and the people in it. These are the stories that you won't see everywhere else.

Capturing the essence of island life through personal stories, community events, and issues that are relevant to where we live.

Be sure to check out channel 4 anytime for a comprehensive look at what we do in Victoria and Duncan.
